name: vdf_fiona
title: Fiona (Vindictus)
note: Fiona's own moves from Vindictus: Defying Fate (user 10-04 "继续" - her game moves were the next step offered). Her AnimSequences exported by UE Viewer (tools/vdf_anims.py), read onto her own skeleton and turned humanoid by VdfAnims. Stance: battle idle; walk: battle walk (backwards: reversed); run: battle run. Strikes with her longsword (RoeBlade: the blade hits, the tip is measured): A Attack_Strong03 thrust, B Guard_Counter slash, C Attack01 spinning slash, D Attack_Strong04 kick and slash (knocks down) - each cut where the swing ends (the game's clips take 2-3 s back to idle). Her game clips (hurt, knockdown, lying, get-up, intro, win, specials) are in tools/vdf/fio005.json.
source: Vindictus: Defying Fate 2024-03 pre-alpha (Nexon): Fiona's AnimSequences, UE Viewer .psa -> VdfAnims
